## Foundation title {#foundation-title .hero-title}

A clear title uses the display face only at the display size.

## Primary prose and hierarchy {#foundation-prose}

A normal paragraph supplies the comparison for an [ordinary link](#foundation-controls).

- An unordered list remains primary ink.
- A second item retains the same body size.

1. An ordered list uses the same 30px role.
2. Reading order has its own clear cue.

## Code and explanation {#foundation-code}

```python
values = [2, 4, 6]
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(mean)
```

## Controls carry explicit jobs {#foundation-controls}

```{=html}
<p><button id="foundation-primary" class="btn btn-primary">Primary action</button> <button class="btn btn-secondary">Secondary action</button></p>
<label for="foundation-name">Project name</label><input id="foundation-name" class="form-control" value="Readable input">
<p><button id="foundation-selected" class="btn btn-primary" aria-pressed="true">✓ Selected</button> <button id="foundation-disabled" class="btn btn-primary" disabled>Unavailable</button></p>
```

## State actions {#foundation-states}

```{=html}
<button class="btn btn-success">✓ Success</button> <button class="btn btn-warning">! Warning</button>
<button class="btn btn-danger">× Error</button> <button class="btn btn-info">i Information</button>
<p><input class="form-control" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="foundation-error" value="?" aria-label="Required identifier"><span id="foundation-error" class="invalid-feedback">× Error: enter an identifier.</span></p>
```

## Semantic hierarchy and authored CSS {#foundation-semantic}

[The key result keeps its semantic role.]{.key}

[Supporting material has a restrained role.]{.aside}

<p id="local-override" class="local-override">An explicit local override remains 42px.</p>

## Built-in audience widgets {#foundation-widgets data-section="Audience metadata"}

```{=html}
<div class="sample-label">A required audience label</div>
<div class="pill-row"><button id="foundation-pill" class="pill" type="button">Pill choice</button><button class="control-chip" type="button">Control chip</button><button class="action-button active" type="button">Action button</button></div>
<div class="media-caption" style="margin-top:24px"><h3>A media heading</h3><p>An audience-readable media caption.</p></div>
<p><button id="foundation-state-selected" class="btn btn-success" aria-pressed="true">✓ Selected success</button><button id="foundation-state-disabled-selected" class="btn btn-success" aria-pressed="true" disabled>Unavailable selected</button></p>
```
